contexts.text: He made for (them) coats of skin () = instructed them in spiritual and in natural good.

That a coat of skin = good spiritual and natural... The general term skin is here used, but that of a kid, sheep, or ram is meant, which animals = affections of good, charity, and the things of charity. AC 296. Illustrated.

The skins of the kids of the goats () = the external truths of domestic good; for skins = external things... because they are the outermosts of the animal, in which its interiors are terminated, in like manner as the skin, or cuticles, in man. This signification is derived from the representation in the other life; these there who are in the province of the skincutis-, and also the skin = external things. Illustrated.
Skins of red rams and skins of badgers () = the external truths and goods by which they are held together; for skins = external things.

Its skin () = what is false in ultimates; for skin, or skin = what is true in ultimates... for those who relate to the skin in the Grand Man are those who are in the truths of faith, and not so much in the corresponding good, who are those in the threshold to Heaven. Hence by the skin, in the abstract sense, is signified truth in ultimates. The reason skin, here = falsity in ultimates, is that when the flesh = the evil of love, its skin = what is false of faith thence.
The coats of skin = the appearances of truth.
Melancthon appeared clad in a hairy skin.
